title: Gather at the Social 7
description: Welcome to your private paradise! Experience the spaciousness of this 7 bedroom, 5 full bath home, 2 Master BR with a secluded backyard thats sure to capture your heart. Conveniently situated between Old Town, TPC, renowned golf courses, the location offers easy access to restaurants and Spring training facilities. After a day of exploring, unwind in style. Whether you prefer relaxing,  excitement, Az sunsets,  8 TV's or enjoying the pool, BBQ, & covered patio the perfect gathering space here.
